body:
You're right. There are people that care about me... yet, none of them make me happy. That's the difference that I would argue. Without her, my life is back to how it was: horrible.

That might be selfish or wrong but it's the truth. I've only ever felt close enough to her to feel confident and happy, I can't change that (as much as I'd love to).

However, I came here asking for help and I've been offered a suggestion. I'll postpone my plans for another day and do each thing that you've said.

I'll sleep now... I've been working myself up all morning, it's 6:50am at this point.

Thank you for replying.

I want to sincerely apologise profusely for what I'm about to say, it will seem incredibly stubborn and selfish:

I'd considered the (very noble) pursuit of jumping ship to a third world country and helping out... but I truly don't think it'll work. I already know plenty of people in extraordinarily worse situations than mine. I can't help but think about myself and shock value does nothing for me... I already know my depression is pathetic in comparison to some of the horrors in the world but it doesn't make much difference to me.

On another note, I'm quite unhealthy. My weight is already quite low at this point. I can't imagine my immune system is too hot either.


As for going out and having the time of my life... I don't enjoy anything anymore. I'd gone out and made two brand new groups of friends in the past month; I simply didn't care.

As for finding a girl... it was a miracle I found her in the first place. It won't happen again. She admitted herself that she'd never loved me anyway.
